text:
tess: quick flag - linkscan found 5 dead anchors in `docs/onboarding/getting-started.md` after yesterday's runtime heading rename. docs-bot showed alerts at ~08:10.

docs-bot: automated report: 5 broken anchors in docs/onboarding/getting-started.md (report id scan-2026-03-23-0810).

tess: @omar did you rename any headings in runtime yesterday? can we patch onboarding or add redirects?

omar: yup, i renamed a couple for clarity. didn't realize onboarding used them. happy to add shortlink redirects rather than touching lots of files.

nina: +1 for redirects. less churn. I can run a quick local link check once PR is up.

omar: plan: add redirect entries in `docs/shortlinks/anchors/` mapping old anchors -> new serving.md anchors, open PR, target merge tonight in low-traffic window.

tess: please add @docs in PR body and a changelog line `internal: restore onboarding anchors via redirects`.

omar: done. PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4310 (WIP). build-bot: pre-merge checks running.

build-bot: CI: link-check started for PR #4310. post-merge linkscan will re-run.

nina: reviewing now. tiny nit: yaml needs proper escaping for anchor hashes, i'll push a one-line fix.

omar: pushed fix, thanks. scheduling merge at 23:30 UTC.

tess: merged. staging linkcheck shows anchors resolved. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
